stories.title: Private Prison Giant Gave Trump-aligned Super PAC $1.4 Million After Landing Mega ICE Contracts
stories.text: GEO Group contributed $1.4 million to a powerful super PAC that supports President Donald Trump and his political agenda just weeks after the private prison and immigration detention center operator scored two massive government contracts. According to Federal Election Commission records reviewed by The Lever , on July 16 MAGA Inc. received $1 million from GEO Reentry Services, LLC, which donated an additional $413,000 to Trump’s $400 million war chest on July 31. GEO Reentry Services is a branch of GEO Group that provides transitional services, such as substance abuse classes and work-readiness skills, to help formerly incarcerated people return to their communities.
